production.note: US model years 2022 to 2025. First: Kelley Blue Book's 2022 718 Cayman trim list includes "GT4 RS Coupe 2D"; PCNA: world premiere at the Los Angeles Auto Show in November 2021, "followed by customer deliveries in 2022" (pcna-2021-718-cayman-gt4-rs). Last: Kelley Blue Book's 2025 718 Cayman page lists the "718 Cayman GT4 RS" and says "production of the 718 Boxster and 718 Cayman is set to end October 2025"; its 2026 718 Cayman address returns the 2025 page (kbb-2025-718-cayman). No opened Porsche page says in so many words that 2025 was the last model year.

configuration.note: "Six-cylinder naturally aspirated boxer engine with gasoline particulate filter"

transmission.note: "Seven-speed dual clutch transmission (PDK)"; PCNA: "offered exclusively with the seven-speed dual-clutch transmission (PDK)". No manual.

powerHp.note: Quote (spec sheet): max. power "493 hp" at "8,400 rpm". PCNA release: "Power increases by 79 hp compared to the 718 Cayman GT4 to a total of 493 hp, resulting in a weight-to-power ratio of 6.55 lbs. per hp." Kelley Blue Book's 2025 page still gives a "493-horsepower engine".

weightLb.note: Single configuration (PDK coupe), standard car. Quote (spec sheet): "Curb Weight (US)" "3,227 lbs." PCNA release: "The U.S. curb weight is 3,227 lbs. – 49 lbs. less than a 718 Cayman GT4 with PDK". No Weissach Package weight was given.

sources.title: Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS: world premiere at the Los Angeles Auto Show
